name: Mangools
shortDescription: Mangools is an all-in-one SEO software suite offering keyword research (KWFinder), SERP analysis, rank tracking, backlink analysis, and site profiling.
summary: Mangools provides a simple and affordable SEO toolset featuring KWFinder for low-difficulty keywords, SERPChecker for SERP analysis, SERPWatcher for rank tracking, LinkMiner for backlink discovery, SiteProfiler for domain insights, and AI search tracking.
